messages:
marta: Heads-up: our Kotlin onboarding sample is flaking in device CI. When a suspend Retrofit call is canceled by a coroutine timeout, OkHttp dispatcher threads accumulate and eventually exhaust the pool on older Android emulators. Anyone seen this pattern?

ben: Yep. Which Retrofit/OkHttp versions and what CANCEL path are you using? The suspend adapter sometimes only calls Call.cancel() and skips Call.timeout().cancel().

marta: Retrofit 2.9.0 + OkHttp 4.9.3. Code is a streaming JSON endpoint and we used withTimeout(1500) around the suspend call. Client has readTimeout disabled (0) and callTimeout left default in many samples.

yuki: HTTP/2? This smells like the HTTP/2 reader thread not being interrupted on some kernels. Forcing HTTP/1_1 often makes the problem go away in my repros.

marta: Yep, HTTP/2 enabled. Forcing Protocol.HTTP_1_1 in the OkHttp client fixed flakiness locally. But we can't force that in user apps so need SDK guidance.

ben: Two practical fixes for onboarding/CI: (1) set a small bounded readTimeout for device tests, or (2) force HTTP_1_1 in test builds. Longer term we should update the suspend adapter to mirror the Java client's cancellation order: call.timeout().cancel() then call.cancel(). That triggers OkHttp's AsyncTimeout path and reduces native-read windows.

yuki: Also try an OkHttp 5.x snapshot; they changed some HTTP/2 shutdown/cancellation wiring which may fix this for real.

marta: I patched the suspend adapter locally to call call.timeout().cancel() before call.cancel(); it helped but didn't eliminate the issue on Android 8.1 emulator. Closing the socket in EventListener.onCanceled solved tests but is hacky and noisy in logs.

ben: For the onboarding docs we should add a small "device-testing" note: explain the cancel semantics and recommend a) testing with a bounded read timeout, b) using Protocol.HTTP_1_1 in CI for flaky images, c) upgrading to OkHttp 5.x when validated. Also include a minimal repro gist and link to internal ticket.

yuki: I'll validate the repro against OkHttp 5 snapshot and report. If 5.x fixes it we can prioritize an upgrade. If not, we should add a compatibility note and a recommended pattern for mapping coroutine cancellations to Call.timeout() + Call.cancel().

qa-bot: CI detected repeated dispatcher-thread-exhaustion in device-tests/android-8-emulator. Logs: https://ci.internal/3322. Created INT-5588 and attached current thread dumps.

marta: Thanks, everyone. I'll publish a tiny sample repo and a short onboarding blurb in docs: "If your app relies on per-request coroutine cancellation on older Android, prefer (1) bounded read timeouts in CI, or (2) use HTTP/1_1 in flaky images; consider upgrading to OkHttp 5.x." Will follow up with INT-5588 details. :thumbsup:
